trials.claim: Lifetime access to No Code MBA Plan
trials.claimQuote:
### No Code MBA: $159 (was $349)
- Lifetime access to No Code MBA Plan
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
trials.reasoning: The prosecution exhibits only describe the vendor's regular renewing monthly or annual membership, which is not evidence against a deal-specific lifetime promise, and no defense exhibit confirms lifetime access for deal buyers.

exhibits.quote: You have access while your membership is active. Choose a monthly or annual plan. Both renew until canceled; canceling stops your next renewal and you keep access through the end of your paid period.
exhibits.argument: Vendor describes access only while a renewing monthly or annual membership is active, not lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: You can access every course while your membership is active.
exhibits.argument: Access is expressly limited to periods when membership is active, contradicting lifetime access.

trials.claim: All future No Code MBA Plan updates included
trials.claimQuote:
- Lifetime access to No Code MBA Plan
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- All future No Code MBA Plan updates
trials.reasoning: The exhibits only show new lessons are included while a regular membership is active and that courses are currently being updated; none confirms deal buyers receive all future updates forever.

exhibits.quote: AI courses and the no-code library are included, along with new lessons added during your membership.
exhibits.argument: Future lessons are limited to those added during membership, not all future updates forever.

exhibits.quote: Your membership includes new lessons published while it is active.
exhibits.argument: Updates are included only if published while membership is active, not all future Plan updates.

exhibits.quote: New lessons are added as tools and workflows change. Your membership includes new lessons published while it is active.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms membership includes new lessons added as tools change.

exhibits.quote: Plus they’re still updating everything, so it’s really a gold mind.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the courses are still being updated.

trials.claimQuote:
- Automate internal processes and workflows with Zapier and Airtable
## Refund
60-day money-back guarantee
trials.reasoning: The vendor states membership comes with a 60-day money-back guarantee and its refund policy tells buyers to contact support within 60 days of purchase; the terms' trial and one-refund limits do not contradict that window.

exhibits.quote: No Code MBA has no obligation to consider or grant refund requests, including (i) for subscription plans purchased with a 7-day or longer free trial.
exhibits.argument: Vendor reserves no obligation to grant refunds in some cases, undermining an unconditional 60-day guarantee.

exhibits.quote: To the extent permissible under applicable law, you are entitled to, at most, one refund only.
exhibits.argument: Refunds are limited to at most one, adding a restriction not stated in the guarantee claim.

exhibits.quote: Your membership comes with a 60-day money-back guarantee.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states membership comes with a 60-day money-back guarantee.

exhibits.quote: If No Code MBA is not a fit, contact support@nocode.mba within 60 days of purchase and include the email address used at checkout.
exhibits.argument: Refund policy confirms refunds can be requested within 60 days of purchase.

trials.claimQuote:
### No Code MBA: $159 (was $349)
- Lifetime access to No Code MBA Plan
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- All future No Code MBA Plan updates
trials.reasoning: No exhibit shows the regular price was $349 or the deal price was $159; prices being changeable and separate tool costs do not prove or disprove those prices.

exhibits.quote: Prices for our products are subject to change without notice.
exhibits.argument: Vendor can change prices at any time, undermining the fixed was $349 anchor price.

exhibits.quote: Tool subscriptions and usage charges are separate from your No Code MBA membership.
exhibits.argument: The $159 price excludes required tool subscriptions and usage charges, making the deal price misleading as total cost.

trials.claim: Learn to build AI apps, marketplaces, websites, automations, and more
trials.claimQuote: Learn how to build AI apps, marketplaces, websites, automations, and more.
trials.reasoning: The vendor confirms guided projects to build and publish an AI writing app and community, and a buyer confirms creating websites and apps; the single complaint about only 3 courses does not materially undercut this.

exhibits.quote: Follow the projects to build and publish a Reddit-style community and an AI writing app.
exhibits.argument: Vendor lists only two specific apps built in projects, not marketplaces, websites, and automations.

exhibits.quote: Not worth the money. Only 3 course, not worth the money. Udemy has things like this for $10 / $15 each.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports only 3 courses, contradicting the broad build-anything catalog claim.

exhibits.quote: Follow the projects to build and publish a Reddit-style community and an AI writing app.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms members build and publish AI apps through guided projects.

exhibits.quote: I can create websites, apps or pretty much anything else that rivals the enterprise solutions
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms they can create websites and apps after using the product.

trials.claim: Learn fundamentals of major no-code tools like Webflow, Bubble, Airtable, Zapier, Glide
trials.claimQuote: Learn the fundamentals of major no-code tools like Webflow, Bubble, Airtable, Zapier, Glide, etc
trials.reasoning: The vendor lists Airtable, Webflow, Bubble, Glide, Zapier and more as covered tools, and a buyer confirms learning Glide and Webflow; outdated videos in places and separate tool subscriptions do not contradict learning their fundamentals.

exhibits.quote: The only negative I see so far is that they need to update some of their videos to reflect updates that the platforms have made.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports tutorials are outdated relative to current platform versions, undermining fundamentals learning claim.

exhibits.quote: Tool subscriptions and usage charges are separate from your No Code MBA membership.
exhibits.argument: Learning the tools requires separate paid tool subscriptions not included in membership.

exhibits.quote: Explore tools such as Airtable, Webflow, Bubble, Glide, Zapier, Figma, and Google Sheets.
exhibits.argument: Vendor lists the major no-code tools covered by membership.

exhibits.quote: I bought this knowing nothing about no code tools like Glide and Webflow.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the training covers no-code tools like Glide and Webflow.
